retry.fact: zero temporary slot selects saved-value splx, zalloc from pv_entry_zone, stores EAX, and jumps to lookup start

consume.fact: temporary node receives virtual, map, old link, becomes bucket head, then local slot clears

cleanup.fact: final saved-value splx is followed by conditional zfree of a still-held temporary node

splvm.fact: raw function body reads level global

limit: No zalloc-null branch, complete SPL acquisition proof, or scheduler-progress claim is asserted.
